hotel.name: Aegean Bliss Resort, Disney World, Orlando, Florida

day_by_day.morning: No activities — flight arrives late at night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities — flight arrives late at night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Take Disney's complimentary Magical Express shuttle or a budget rideshare (Lyft/Uber ~$25-35) to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Check in, unpack essentials, and review your park tickets and plans for the week.

meals.breakfast: N/A — in transit
meals.lunch: N/A — in transit
meals.dinner: Grab a quick bite at the airport before or after landing — try Burger King or Subway inside Orlando International Airport to keep costs low (~$10-12 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Keep energy high for tomorrow! Download the My Disney Experience app tonight to set up park reservations, check wait times, and link tickets. Pick up snacks at a resort gift shop or vending machine to avoid overpaying tomorrow morning. Set an early alarm — parks open at 9:00 AM.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Magic Kingdom — arrive at least 30 minutes before park opening (aim for 8:30 AM) to take advantage of Early Entry if your resort qualifies. Hit the most popular rides first: Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Use the My Disney Experience app to grab Lightning Lane passes strategically.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom's Fantasyland and Tomorrowland. Watch the afternoon parade (check the schedule on the app). Take a mid-afternoon break back at the resort if needed — the heat in June can be intense. Refill reusable water bottles at park water fountains (free!) to stay hydrated.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening. Watch the spectacular Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle (typically around 9:00 PM). Take the complimentary Disney bus back to Aegean Bliss Resort.

meals.breakfast: Eat a hearty breakfast at the resort before heading out — grab grab-and-go items from the resort food court (~$8-12 per person) to save time and money.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — budget-friendly counter service with lobster rolls, fish, and chicken options (~$12-16 per person). Split a combo meal to save.
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — one of Magic Kingdom's most affordable counter-service spots. Burgers, rotisserie chicken, and hot dogs (~$12-15 per person).

day_by_day.notes: June weather in Orlando is hot and humid (highs around 90°F/32°C) with frequent afternoon thunderstorms. Bring ponchos (buy cheap ones before the trip — in-park ponchos cost ~$12 each). Apply sunscreen generously. Magic Kingdom is typically the busiest park, so arrive early to maximize your time.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT — arrive early for rope drop. Start with the newly expanded World Discovery area: experience Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (one of Disney's most thrilling new rides) and Test Track. Use Lightning Lane for the most popular attractions. Explore the stunning World Showcase pavilions as they open.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon exploring EPCOT's World Showcase — walk through the international pavilions (Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada). Enjoy cultural performances and free entertainment throughout the showcase. Visit the Frozen Ever After ride in the Norway pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's nighttime spectacular — Luminous: The Symphony of Us, a stunning nighttime show over World Showcase Lagoon. Grab a budget-friendly snack from one of the World Showcase kiosks before heading back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the resort food court before leaving — oatmeal, eggs, or continental breakfast items (~$8-10 per person).
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — one of EPCOT's best budget counter-service options with fresh salads, sandwiches, and hot entrées (~$12-15 per person).
meals.dinner: Pick up food from multiple World Showcase kiosks — try a couple of small plates from different countries for a fun, affordable international dining experience (~$15-20 per person total).

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is massive — wear comfortable walking shoes. The World Showcase doesn't fully open until 11:00 AM, so use the morning for rides in World Discovery and World Nature. Many pavilion restaurants are pricey — stick to counter service and festival kiosks for budget dining. Check if the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival is running during your visit for extra food kiosk options.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Hollywood Studios — arrive early for rope drop. Make a beeline for Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge to ride Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive experiences) and Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. These rides have the longest waits, so hitting them first is critical. Alternatively, use Lightning Lane if available.
day_by_day.afternoon: Experience Toy Story Land — ride Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania. Then head to Sunset Boulevard for Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster (thrill seekers' favorites). Watch the Lightning McQueen's Racing Academy show for a fun, free, air-conditioned break.
day_by_day.evening: Catch the Fantasmic! nighttime show at Hollywood Hills Amphitheater — an incredible water, fire, and projection spectacular. Check show times on the app and arrive 30-45 minutes early for good seats. Take the bus back to the resort after the show.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast from the resort before heading out — pack a banana and granola bar from a grocery run to save money.
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — one of Hollywood Studios' most popular and budget-friendly counter-service spots. Try the BBQ Brisket Melt or Totchos (~$12-15 per person). Expect a line but it moves quickly.
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary — a classic Hollywood Studios counter-service restaurant with burgers, sandwiches, and flatbreads in a cool, air-conditioned setting (~$13-16 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is a smaller park but packed with high-demand attractions. Lightning Lane purchases are strongly recommended for Rise of the Resistance if you can't snag a boarding group. Fantasmic! is free with park admission but seating is first-come, first-served. The park can feel crowded in June — use the app constantly to monitor wait times and adjust your plan.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Animal Kingdom — arrive early for rope drop. Start with Avatar Flight of Passage in Pandora: The World of Avatar (often the longest wait in the park — get there first!). Then ride Na'vi River Journey nearby. The lush, immersive theming of Pandora is stunning in the morning light.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa and Asia sections of the park. Ride Kilimanjaro Safaris (best in the morning or late afternoon when animals are most active — try to squeeze in a second ride if time allows). Experience Expedition Everest in Asia and Kali River Rapids (you WILL get wet — great for a hot June afternoon). Watch the Festival of the Lion King show — a spectacular live performance.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the Rivers of Light nighttime show or explore the Tree of Life as it comes alive with projected animal imagery after dark. Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (typically 8:00-9:00 PM). Head back to the resort and relax — consider a swim at the Aegean Bliss Resort pool.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the resort before leaving — a full breakfast will fuel a big morning of walking (~$8-12 per person at the food court).
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — widely considered one of Disney World's best counter-service meals. Ribs, pulled pork, and chicken in a beautiful outdoor waterfront setting (~$14-18 per person).
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Local Food Cafes (counter service) in Asia — Asian-inspired dishes like teriyaki beef bowls and Asian salads at reasonable prices (~$12-15 per person). Avoid the full-service Yak & Yeti restaurant to stay on budget.

day_by_day.notes: Bring a change of clothes or a poncho for Kali River Rapids — you will get soaked. Animal Kingdom is the most outdoorsy of the four parks, so sunscreen and hats are essential. The park is also home to real animals, so be respectful and quiet near animal viewing areas. Kilimanjaro Safaris is best experienced twice — morning and late afternoon — for different animal activity.

day_by_day.morning: Take a budget-friendly break from the theme parks! Spend the morning at the Aegean Bliss Resort's beachfront area and pool — enjoy the resort amenities you've been paying for all week. Sleep in, relax, and recharge. This is a great day to do laundry, reorganize, and review remaining activities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Disney Springs — Disney's free outdoor shopping, dining, and entertainment district (no park ticket required). Browse the unique shops, watch street performers, and soak in the atmosphere. Visit the LEGO Store, World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store in the world), and browse the many entertainment options. The Splitsville Luxury Lanes bowling alley is a fun option if budget allows (~$15-25 per person).
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy dinner and evening entertainment at Disney Springs. Watch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater if a good film is showing (~$15-18 per person), or simply enjoy the free entertainment, live music, and people-watching along the waterfront.

meals.breakfast: Sleep in and enjoy a relaxed resort breakfast — visit the resort food court for a full hot breakfast (~$10-14 per person). Treat yourself a little — you've earned it!
meals.lunch: Earl of Sandwich at Disney Springs — one of the best budget dining values at Disney World. Hot, toasted sandwiches, salads, and soups at very reasonable prices (~$10-13 per person). Highly recommended!
meals.dinner: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza at Disney Springs — build-your-own artisan pizzas that are quick, affordable, and delicious (~$10-13 per person). Great for families.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and parking is also free — a great way to experience Disney magic without spending on park tickets. This rest day is strategically placed before your final full park day to ensure everyone has energy for the grand finale. Use this day to purchase any last-minute souvenirs — Disney Springs often has better prices than the parks themselves.

day_by_day.morning: Return to your favorite park for one last magical morning — most guests choose Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for their farewell visit. Arrive at rope drop and revisit your favorite rides and attractions. Pick up any last-minute souvenirs. Take photos at iconic spots: Cinderella Castle, the EPCOT ball (Spaceship Earth), or the Hollywood Studios water tower.
day_by_day.afternoon: Wrap up your park visit by early afternoon (around 2:00-3:00 PM). Head back to the resort to pack, shower, and check out (or store luggage with the bell desk if checkout was earlier). Take one final walk around the Aegean Bliss Resort's beachfront to soak in the views and reflect on a magical week.
day_by_day.evening: Depart for Orlando International Airport. Allow at least 2.5-3 hours before your flight for travel time and security. Take a rideshare or Disney transport. Grab a final Florida meal at the airport — or pack snacks from the resort to save money on the journey home.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — go a little bigger to fuel your last park morning (~$10-14 per person at the food court). Alternatively, pack snacks and grab coffee to save money for one last park splurge.
meals.lunch: Revisit your favorite counter-service spot from the week — or try something new you missed. Budget ~$13-16 per person for a satisfying farewell park meal.
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Orlando International — Chick-fil-A, Subway, or grab a sit-down meal at one of the terminal restaurants (~$12-18 per person). Keep receipts for any remaining travel budget.

day_by_day.notes: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort by the standard checkout time (usually 11:00 AM) or request a late checkout if your departure allows. The bell desk can store luggage for free while you enjoy your last few hours. Don't forget to return any rental items, check for lost belongings, and take a final look around your room. Save a small budget buffer (~$20-30) for unexpected airport expenses or tips. Most importantly — cherish the memories made this week!

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight arrives late night
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – In transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Collect luggage, arrange Disney's Magical Express or a rideshare to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, unpack essentials, and get a good night's rest to prepare for the week ahead.

meals.breakfast: N/A – In transit
meals.lunch: N/A – In transit
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite at the airport (Chick-fil-A or Auntie Anne's in Terminal B) or a light snack from the resort's lobby convenience area upon arrival.

day_by_day.notes: Do not schedule any park activities tonight. Pre-download the My Disney Experience app, link your park tickets, and set up MagicBand+ if purchased. Confirm resort check-in details in advance to ensure a smooth late-night arrival. Hydrate and rest — big days ahead!

day_by_day.morning: Start the day with a resort breakfast, then head to Magic Kingdom Park for rope drop (park typically opens at 9:00 AM). Arrive 30–45 minutes early to beat crowds. Prioritize Lightning Lane selections for Space Mountain, Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, and TRON Lightcycle Run. Explore Fantasyland and Tomorrowland in the cooler morning hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom — visit Pirates of the Caribbean, Haunted Mansion, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Take a midday break (1:00–3:00 PM) back at the resort or find air-conditioned spots inside the park like the Carousel of Progress to avoid peak heat and crowds.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening. Watch the iconic 'Disney Enchantment' fireworks spectacular over Cinderella Castle (typically at 9:00 PM). Ride any remaining attractions with shorter evening wait times before park close.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — fuel up before the long park day.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — mid-range counter service with clam chowder, fish & chips, and lobster rolls (~$15–$20 per person).
meals.dinner: The Plaza Restaurant on Main Street U.S.A. — a charming table-service spot with classic American fare like burgers, sandwiches, and milkshakes (~$20–$35 per person). Reserve via My Disney Experience in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass early in the morning via the My Disney Experience app. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen, hats, and a portable fan. Magic Kingdom is the most iconic park — plan to spend the full day here. Check the My Disney Experience app for real-time wait times.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT for the EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour. Arrive at park open and start with Future World / World Discovery — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track early before lines build. Use Lightning Lane for top attractions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transition into the World Showcase (opens at 11:00 AM). Stroll through all 11 country pavilions — Canada, UK, France, Morocco, Japan, USA, Italy, Germany, China, Norway, and Mexico. Sample authentic cuisine and snacks from each pavilion. Don't miss the Norway pavilion's Frozen Ever After ride and Mexico's Gran Fiesta Tour.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Harmonious' nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check current show schedule). Enjoy a leisurely dinner in the World Showcase before the show.

meals.breakfast: Quick continental breakfast at the resort or grab a croissant and café au lait at the France pavilion bakery (Les Halles Boulangerie-Patisserie) upon arriving at EPCOT.
meals.lunch: Graze through World Showcase pavilions — try School Bread from Norway (~$6), Beef Gyoza from Japan (~$8), and a Margarita from Mexico (~$12). Budget ~$25–$35 for a fun food-crawl lunch.
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion — hibachi-style table-service dining with entertaining chefs (~$30–$45 per person). Reserve well in advance through My Disney Experience.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is ideal for food lovers and culturally curious families. Bring a small cooler bag or refillable water bottle — the park is largely outdoors and June heat can be intense. The EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival may be running in June — check Disney's official calendar for special booths and entertainment.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a relaxed morning at Aegean Bliss Resort — sleep in, enjoy the pool, or take a leisurely breakfast. Head to Disney Springs for the Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day experience. Arrive by 10:30 AM as shops open. Explore unique boutiques like World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store), LEGO Store, and Marketplace Co-Op.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue at Disney Springs — visit entertainment venues like Splitsville Luxury Lanes (bowling + dining), check out free live entertainment on the waterfront stages, and browse the vibrant marketplace. This is a great lower-key day to recharge mid-trip.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy dinner and evening entertainment at Disney Springs. Catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater or enjoy live music at the House of Blues. Walk the illuminated waterfront promenade before heading back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Relaxed resort breakfast — enjoy the full buffet or order room service for a slow morning.
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs — gourmet burgers with creative toppings in a fun atmosphere (~$15–$22 per person). Counter service, no reservation needed.
meals.dinner: Paddlefish at Disney Springs — a stunning multi-deck restaurant aboard a steamboat serving fresh seafood and steaks (~$30–$50 per person). Reserve in advance for a waterfront table at sunset.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter — no park ticket required. This is a great recovery day mid-week to rest legs and recharge energy. It's also an excellent shopping opportunity for souvenirs and Disney merchandise. Parking at Disney Springs is free in the garages.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for the Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience. Arrive at park open for the Kilimanjaro Safari — morning is the best time to spot active wildlife including elephants, giraffes, lions, and hippos. The golden morning light also makes for stunning photos. Book a Lightning Lane for Avatar Flight of Passage immediately upon entry.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Pandora – The World of Avatar after the safari. Ride Avatar: Flight of Passage (a breathtaking must-do) and Na'vi River Journey. Explore the bioluminescent landscape of Pandora. Visit Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close animal encounters. Catch the 'Festival of the Lion King' live show — a spectacular Broadway-style performance.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for Animal Kingdom's evening — if the park has extended hours, enjoy the illuminated Pandora at dusk when the bioluminescent plants glow beautifully. Head back to the resort for a relaxing dinner and early rest.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the resort or pick up coffee and a breakfast wrap at Creature Comforts (Starbucks location) inside Animal Kingdom.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — the best quick-service restaurant in Animal Kingdom with healthy grain bowls, proteins, and alien-themed desserts (~$15–$22 per person). Mobile order recommended.
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant at Animal Kingdom — pan-Asian cuisine in a stunning Himalayan-themed setting with dishes like Crispy Honey Chicken and Kobe Beef Burger (~$20–$35 per person). Or opt for a resort dinner at Aegean Bliss for a relaxed evening.

day_by_day.notes: Avatar: Flight of Passage is one of the most popular attractions at all of Disney World — book Lightning Lane Individual Selection for this ride as early as 7:00 AM on the day of your visit. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks, so plan accordingly. Wear bug spray as the park is heavily forested.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Hollywood Studios for the Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure. Arrive at rope drop and go directly to Galaxy's Edge. Book a time slot for Savi's Workshop – Handbuilt Lightsabers ($249.99 per lightsaber — a premium splurge worth budgeting for). Alternatively, visit the Droid Depot to build a custom droid (~$119.99). Ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run first thing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Ride Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance — one of the most technologically advanced theme park attractions ever built. Use Lightning Lane Individual Selection. Explore the rest of Hollywood Studios: ride Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania in Toy Story Land, and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith (if available). Catch the 'Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular' live show.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for 'Fantasmic!' — Hollywood Studios' iconic nighttime lagoon show featuring Mickey Mouse, Disney villains, and stunning water/projection effects (check showtimes, typically 8:00 or 9:30 PM). This is a bucket-list Disney experience. Head back to resort after the show.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast before rope drop — pack a granola bar or grab a quick bite at the resort's café.
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — themed Star Wars quick-service dining with dishes like Smoked Kaadu Ribs and Fried Endorian Tip-Yip (~$15–$22 per person). Mobile order to save time.
meals.dinner: 50's Prime Time Café at Hollywood Studios — a nostalgic diner experience with classic American comfort food like pot roast, meatloaf, and milkshakes served by 'family member' cast members (~$20–$35 per person). Reserve in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop requires advance reservations — book as soon as possible through My Disney Experience (60 days in advance for resort guests). Galaxy's Edge is extremely popular on weekends; arrive early. 'Fantasmic!' dining packages are available that include reserved show seating — consider booking one for guaranteed seats.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a final leisurely morning at Aegean Bliss Resort — take one last swim at the pool, pack souvenirs carefully, and enjoy a relaxed resort breakfast. Check out of the resort (or store luggage with the concierge if your flight is later). Make a final visit to any park or Disney Springs for last-minute souvenir shopping.
day_by_day.afternoon: If time allows before departure, revisit your favorite park for a few final rides using any remaining Lightning Lane credits, or return to Disney Springs for last-minute gifts and treats. Pick up Mickey-shaped Rice Krispie treats, Ghirardelli chocolate, or specialty candy at the Marketplace for friends and family back home.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange transportation to Orlando International Airport (allow 60–90 minutes travel + security time). Reflect on an incredible week at Walt Disney World. Enjoy a final airport meal before your flight home.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast — treat yourself to a proper sit-down meal on the final morning. Enjoy the resort ambiance one last time.
meals.lunch: Chef Art Smith's Homecomin' at Disney Springs — Southern comfort food with famous Fried Chicken & Doughnuts, deviled eggs, and moonshine cocktails (~$20–$35 per person). A wonderful farewell Florida meal.
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Orlando International — grab a meal at one of the terminal restaurants such as Vino Volo wine bar or Outback Steakhouse Airside before your flight.

day_by_day.notes: Resort checkout is typically 11:00 AM — request a late checkout (12:00–1:00 PM) if your flight is in the evening. Bell services can hold your luggage after checkout so you can enjoy the resort or nearby areas. Ensure all park tickets, MagicBands, and Lightning Lane reservations are settled. Save the My Disney Experience app data for future trip planning!

meals.dinner: Late-night room service at Aegean Bliss Resort — order from the premium in-room dining menu featuring gourmet burgers, pasta, and desserts; available until midnight

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange private airport transfer before departure. Request early check-in or luggage storage if needed. Confirm resort concierge has your Disney park tickets, Lightning Lane Multi Pass, and dining reservations ready for review first thing in the morning. Keep Day 1 light — rest is essential for a full week of theme park adventures.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a resort breakfast before heading to Magic Kingdom Park for rope drop (park opens at 9:00 AM). Take advantage of early morning crowds being lightest — prioritize Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, Space Mountain, and TRON Lightcycle Run using Lightning Lane Individual selections booked in advance. Explore Fantasyland and Tomorrowland at a relaxed, premium pace.
day_by_day.afternoon: After lunch, experience Pirates of the Caribbean, Haunted Mansion, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Use Lightning Lane Multi Pass to skip standby queues. Explore Liberty Square and Adventureland. Allow time for a mid-afternoon resort break — return to Aegean Bliss for pool time or spa relaxation during the hottest part of the day (2–4 PM), then return refreshed for the evening.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the spectacular EPCOT-area fireworks or Magic Kingdom's 'Disney Enchantment' nighttime spectacular and Main Street Electrical Parade (confirm current show schedule for June 2027). Stay for the full fireworks display over Cinderella Castle — an unforgettable luxury experience. Arrange a private fireworks dessert party through Disney's premium events team for reserved viewing with exclusive treats.

meals.breakfast: Cinderella's Royal Table inside Magic Kingdom Castle — a character dining experience with a prix-fixe breakfast featuring Mickey waffles, eggs Benedict, and pastries (book 60 days in advance)
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant — Magic Kingdom's most elegant dining experience set inside Beast's enchanted castle; order the French onion soup and braised pork
meals.dinner: Victoria & Albert's at Grand Floridian Resort — Disney World's only AAA Five Diamond restaurant offering a multi-course tasting menu with wine pairings; one of the finest dining experiences in all of Florida (reserve 60 days in advance)

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Individual selections for TRON Lightcycle Run and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train the moment the park opens at 7:00 AM via the My Disney Experience app. Wear comfortable premium sneakers. Bring a portable fan and cooling towel for June heat. The private fireworks dessert party is an additional cost but provides unmatched viewing and is highly recommended for luxury travelers.

day_by_day.date: 2027-06-17 (Wednesday) — EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour
day_by_day.morning: Begin the EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour with a guided premium experience starting at park open. Start in Future World / World Discovery — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (Lightning Lane Individual required) and Test Track. Explore the stunning new World Celebration and World Nature areas, including the awe-inspiring Spaceship Earth ride.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transition to the World Showcase starting at the American Adventure pavilion and work around the lagoon. Sample authentic cuisine and cultural performances in Mexico (La Cava del Tequila margaritas), Japan (Mitsukoshi cultural exhibits), France (crêpes and macarons), and Morocco. Engage with live cultural performers, artisans, and storytellers at each pavilion. Book a private World Showcase cultural tour through Disney's VIP Tour Services for a personalized guide.
day_by_day.evening: Conclude the day with EPCOT's 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Harmonious' nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon — one of Disney's most breathtaking shows. Secure a premium IllumiNations Sparkling Dessert Party spot for reserved lagoon-front seating with unlimited desserts and beverages (book through Disney Special Events). Stroll the illuminated World Showcase promenade after the show.

meals.breakfast: Sunshine Seasons in The Land Pavilion — fresh, farm-to-table breakfast options including omelets, grain bowls, and seasonal fruit; casual but high quality
meals.lunch: Teppan Edo in Japan Pavilion — premium teppanyaki dining with skilled chefs preparing wagyu beef, fresh seafood, and vegetables tableside in an authentic setting
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul in France Pavilion — EPCOT's most upscale restaurant, a French fine dining gem serving classic French cuisine with an exceptional wine list; reserve well in advance

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is the largest Disney park — wear comfortable shoes and consider a mid-afternoon resort retreat if traveling with young children. The EPCOT Food & Wine Festival runs seasonally (typically fall) but the World Showcase food booths offer year-round sampling. Book Disney VIP Tour Services ($425–$850/hour, 7-hour minimum) for an unparalleled guided experience with front-of-line access across the entire park.

day_by_day.date: 2027-06-18 (Thursday) — Hollywood Studios & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure
day_by_day.morning: Arrive at Hollywood Studios at rope drop for the Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure. Head immediately to Galaxy's Edge — join the virtual queue or Lightning Lane for Rise of the Resistance, the most immersive theme park attraction ever built. Experience the full Star Wars story with jaw-dropping Audio-Animatronics and set design. Then head to Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run for an interactive piloting experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber — a premium, deeply personal experience requiring advance reservations ($299 per lightsaber; worth every penny for Star Wars fans). Explore Oga's Cantina for exotic themed beverages in an authentic alien bar setting. Then shift to the rest of Hollywood Studios — ride Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania in Toy Story Land, followed by the thrilling Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster in Sunset Boulevard.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the 'Fantasmic!' nighttime spectacular at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater — secure premium Fantasmic! Dining Package seats through a participating restaurant for guaranteed reserved seating. After the show, enjoy a leisurely walk through the beautifully lit Hollywood Boulevard before heading back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: In-room resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss — order a full gourmet spread via room service (eggs, smoked salmon, fresh-pressed juices, pastries) for a relaxed start before heading to the park
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — the most authentic Star Wars dining in the galaxy, featuring unique dishes like Smoked Kaadu Ribs and Fried Endorian Tip-Yip; immersive theming makes it a must
meals.dinner: Brown Derby in Hollywood Studios — the park's flagship fine dining restaurant inspired by the legendary Hollywood landmark; enjoy the Cobb salad (invented here), prime beef, and an extensive California wine list

day_by_day.notes: Book Savi's Workshop reservations exactly 60 days in advance — they sell out immediately. Rise of the Resistance Lightning Lane Individual is essential and should be purchased the moment the park opens at 7:00 AM. The Droid Depot (build your own droid, ~$119) is another premium Galaxy's Edge experience worth considering if budget and time allow. Bring a dedicated bag for lightsaber transport home.

day_by_day.morning: Depart early for Animal Kingdom to experience the Kilimanjaro Safari at sunrise — the absolute best time to see active African wildlife including elephants, lions, giraffes, rhinos, and hippos in their expansive savanna habitat. Book the premium 'Wild Africa Trek' ($189–$249 per person) for a behind-the-scenes guided safari with exclusive rope bridges over crocodile pools and a private savanna dining experience — the ultimate luxury wildlife encounter.
day_by_day.afternoon: Journey to Pandora – The World of Avatar for the Avatar Flight of Passage — the most technologically advanced ride in Disney history, offering a breathtaking banshee flight over Pandora's bioluminescent landscape (Lightning Lane Individual required). Experience Na'vi River Journey for a serene boat ride through a glowing rainforest. Explore the rest of Animal Kingdom — visit the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail, Maharajah Jungle Trek, and the DINOSAUR attraction in DinoLand.
day_by_day.evening: As the sun sets, Pandora's bioluminescent landscape comes alive in the evening — revisit the land for the magical nighttime glow effect on the plants and structures. Watch the 'Rivers of Light' show or 'Tree of Life Awakening' projections on the iconic Tree of Life. Depart for a relaxed, elegant resort dinner and an early night to recharge.

meals.breakfast: Tusker House Restaurant — a character dining experience with Donald Duck and friends; enjoy an African-inspired breakfast buffet featuring specialty pastries, carved meats, and exotic fruit (book 60 days in advance)
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — Avatar-themed premium quick service with unique protein bowls, grains, and alien-inspired desserts; the Cheeseburger Steamed Pod is an iconic must-try
meals.dinner: Tiffins Restaurant at Animal Kingdom — Disney's most sophisticated Animal Kingdom dining experience featuring globally inspired cuisine, rare artwork from Disney Imagineers, and an exceptional wine and cocktail program; try the whole-roasted cauliflower and the sustainable seafood

day_by_day.notes: The Wild Africa Trek must be booked well in advance and is one of the most exclusive experiences Disney offers — highly recommended for luxury travelers. Flight of Passage Lightning Lane Individual is essential — purchase at 7:00 AM sharp. Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (typically 8–9 PM) so plan accordingly. The park is most beautiful at golden hour — time your Pandora visit for just before sunset.

day_by_day.date: 2027-06-20 (Saturday) — Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day & Resort Luxury Day
day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a leisurely late morning at Aegean Bliss Resort — sleep in, enjoy a full resort breakfast, and spend time at the pool, spa, or beachfront. Book a morning spa treatment at the resort's luxury spa (couples massage, facial, or hydrotherapy experience). This is a purposeful slower day to recharge mid-trip, especially important for families with children.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Disney Springs for the Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day experience. Explore the 4 distinct neighborhoods — The Landing, Marketplace, Town Center, and West Side. Visit the LEGO Store, World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store on Earth), and unique boutiques. Experience the Aerophile — the world's largest tethered helium balloon for panoramic views over Disney property. Enjoy live entertainment, street performers, and musicians throughout the afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Catch a show at the AMC Disney Springs 24 Theatre (premium IMAX or Dolby Cinema experience) or enjoy the Cirque du Soleil 'Drawn to Life' show — a breathtaking acrobatic performance celebrating Disney animation (book tickets in advance). End the evening with a premium dinner at Disney Springs before returning to the resort for a relaxing night.

meals.breakfast: Aegean Bliss Resort's signature restaurant — full gourmet resort breakfast with made-to-order eggs, premium buffet, fresh juices, and pastries while overlooking the beachfront
meals.lunch: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — a nautical-themed waterfront restaurant featuring prime steaks, fresh Maine lobster, and raw bar selections; dine on the open-air terrace overlooking the marina with vintage amphicars in view
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia at Disney Springs — Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship restaurant offering Pan-Asian cuisine including Peking duck, sushi, dim sum, and wagyu beef in a stunning two-story dining room; the omakase experience is exceptional

day_by_day.notes: Cirque du Soleil 'Drawn to Life' tickets should be booked in advance — premium seating in the center section provides the best sightlines. Disney Springs is free to enter with no park ticket required. The Aerophile balloon is weather-dependent and may not operate in high winds or rain — have a backup plan. This intentionally lighter day prevents theme park fatigue and keeps energy high for the final park day.

day_by_day.date: 2027-06-21 (Sunday) — Grand Finale: Return to Favorite Park & Farewell
day_by_day.morning: On the final full day, return to whichever park the family loved most (poll everyone the night before!) or split the morning between Magic Kingdom and EPCOT via the Disney Skyliner gondola system for a scenic, premium inter-park transit experience. Use any remaining Lightning Lane passes and revisit must-do attractions. Consider booking a Disney VIP Tour for this final day to maximize every remaining moment with front-of-line access across any park.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy a final leisurely afternoon at the resort — pool time, beach relaxation, or last-minute souvenir shopping at the resort's boutique shops. Pack non-essential items and prepare luggage for departure. Schedule a resort photographer or Disney's PhotoPass photographer for final family portraits at the most scenic resort locations. Download and purchase the full week's Memory Maker photos through My Disney Experience.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a grand farewell dinner at the resort or at a top Disney restaurant. After dinner, take a final sunset stroll along the Aegean Bliss beachfront, reflecting on an extraordinary week. Arrange a private luxury car transfer to Orlando International Airport for your departure flight. Check out with the concierge and ensure all resort charges, Memory Maker downloads, and special keepsakes are collected.

meals.breakfast: California Grill atop Disney's Contemporary Resort — a legendary Disney dining institution with panoramic Magic Kingdom views; the Sunday brunch features sushi, wood-fired flatbreads, and prime cuts with bottomless mimosas (reservations essential)
meals.lunch: Paddlefish at Disney Springs — a stunning multi-level seafood restaurant aboard a permanently docked riverboat; enjoy the lobster bisque, stone crab claws, and fresh oysters on the open-air top deck
meals.dinner: Narcoossee's at Grand Floridian Resort — an elegant waterfront fine dining restaurant with views of Magic Kingdom and Seven Seas Lagoon; the Maine lobster, prime beef tenderloin, and housemade desserts are exceptional; watch Magic Kingdom fireworks from the waterfront terrace as a perfect farewell

day_by_day.notes: Memory Maker (Disney's photo package, ~$199) should be purchased before the trip for unlimited digital downloads of all PhotoPass and ride photos — a tremendous value for a luxury family trip. Schedule airport transfer 3 hours before domestic departure or 4 hours before international. Confirm all resort charges 24 hours before checkout to avoid surprises. Request a late checkout (12–2 PM) from the resort concierge to enjoy the final morning without rush. Tip resort concierge, housekeeping, and any personal guides generously — they will have made this trip extraordinary.

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June 2026
